verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments API, so idempotent retries are a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions idempotency keys, idempotent request headers, or protection against duplicate charges on retry. The sandbox and payment-creation docs are about other capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
